exposure: previous caesarean delivery before 32 weeks of amenorrhea
cohort: 62 patients with a singleton pregnancy delivery before 32 weeks of amenorrhea, out of 292 consecutive patients identified.
finding: After an early caesarean section, trial of vaginal delivery can be implemented if local conditions are favorable, with no difference in maternal morbidity, success of labour and neonatal outcome if previous caesarean section was performed before 32 weeks or at term.
